dfs1.description: Has fear of dental work ever caused you to put off making an appointment?

dfs10.description: Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Sitting in the waiting room.

dfs5.description: When having dental work done, I perspire.

dfs6.description: When having dental work done, I feel nauseated and sick to my stomach.

idaf1a.description: (1a) I feel anxious shortly before going to the dentist.

idaf1b.description: (1b) I generally avoid going to the dentist because I find the experience unpleasant or distressing.

idaf1c.description: (1c) I get nervous or edgy about upcoming dental visits.

idaf1d.description: (1d) I think that something really bad would happen to me if I were to visit a dentist.

idaf1e.description: (1e) I feel afraid or fearful when visiting the dentist.

idaf1f.description: (1f) My heart beats faster when I go to the dentist.

idaf1g.description: (1g) I delay making appointments to go to the dentist.

idaf1h.description: (1h) I often think about all the things that might go wrong prior to going to the dentist.

idaf2a.description: (2a) Going to the dentist is actively avoided or else endured with intense fear or anxiety

idaf2b.description: (2b) My fear of going to the dentist has been present for at least 6 month

idaf2c.description: (2c) My fear, anxiety or avoidance of going to the dentist significantly affects my life in some way (dental pain, avoiding eating some foods, embarrassed or self-conscious about appearance of teeth or mouth, etc.)

idaf2d.description: (2d) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am concerned I may have a panic attack (abrupt fear with sweating, pounding liteart, fear of dying or losing control, chest pain etc.)

idaf2e.description: (2e) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am generally highly self-conscious or concerned about being watched or judged in social situations.

idaf3c.description: (3c)  Not being in control of what is happening

idaf3f.description: (3f)  Not knowing what the dentist is going to do

idaf3j.description: (3j)  Having an unsympathetic or unkind dentist

idaf_flag.description: The participant have idaf value or not.
